title: amm-ds/portfolio
summary: 该项目提供了一个包含多个机器学习和人工智能案例研究的平台，涵盖代理AI、需求预测、异常检测、NLP微调、客户流失、VRPTW优化、LLM推理服务和提升建模等。它提供了实时API端点、类型化合约、DVC管道和诚实的基线，支持Python语言。
description: Ten reproducible ML/AI case studies — agentic AI & RAG, demand forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP fine-tuning, churn, VRPTW optimization, LLM inference serving, uplift modeling — with live API endpoints, typed contracts, DVC pipelines, and honest baselines throughout.
